title: slide-vision-segmenter output (one visual component)
description: Schema for ONE visual-component object emitted by the slide-vision-segmenter subagent. The agent writes one such object per line (JSONL) for every component it sees across its deck's rendered slides. merge_validate_analysis.py (--mode segment) hard-validates representative_element_id + every member_element_ids entry against the inventory before writing workspace/slide_components.jsonl.

component_id.description: Stable id for this visual component within the deck. Convention: <deck_id>:s<slide_index>:c<n> (e.g. 7f541b4845a8:s1:c2).

deck_id.description: The 12-hex deck id, copied verbatim from the inventory.

slide_index.description: 0-based slide index (matches the container index in element ids and the rendered slide_<index>.png).

component_type.description: What the region IS visually, regardless of how python-pptx fragmented it. table/chart/kpi-grid/performance-history are DATA component types: they REQUIRE a non-null bbox + proposed_data_category and a data-primitive proposed_authoring_component (see allOf).

label.description: The human-visible label/heading of the region as drawn (e.g. 'Portfolio Sector Weightings'). Empty string if none.

representative_element_id.description: A REAL member element_id (must appear in member_element_ids and in the inventory) that best anchors this component — prefer a native table/chart shape, else the largest/heading shape. The component-level classification is written under this id.

member_element_ids.description: Every inventory element_id that visually belongs to this component (the loose text boxes + freeforms + table that compose it). At least one; all must exist in the inventory for this slide.

proposed_data_category.description: The investment-data-category the component carries, or null for non-data components. Same vocabulary as the classifier. REQUIRED (non-null) for data component types (table/chart/kpi-grid/performance-history) — 'reference-other' is the honest fallback when the category is unclear.

proposed_authoring_component.description: The Assette primitive this component implies (same enum as the classifier). Used by the component-aware classify merge.

confidence.description: Honest confidence that this is one coherent component with these members.

rationale.description: One to three sentences: what the region is and the visual evidence that these shapes form it (and, when relevant, why it is distinct from a neighbouring component).

bbox.description: Bounding box of the component in the rendered image, normalized 0..1 as [left, top, right, bottom]. REQUIRED (non-null) for data component types (table/chart/kpi-grid/performance-history) — the analyzer crops to it; set it carefully. Optional for non-data components.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes (e.g. 'two sub-tables share this region; split into 2 components').
